page_title: Claudoscope | Claude Code Session Viewer for macOS

summary.name: Claudoscope
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS app for browsing, replaying, and tracking the cost of Claude Code session transcripts stored locally on your Mac.
use_cases: Browse and search past Claude Code sessions
See token and cost per message in a Claude chat
Replay a session on a timeline to review tool calls and subagents
Get notified when Claude Code needs input or finishes a turn
Set spending alerts for sessions, time windows, or days
summary.what_it_does: Claudoscope reads the JSONL transcript files Claude Code writes under ~/.claude/projects/ and shows each session as a readable chat with tokens and cost on every message. A Trace tab lays a session out on a time axis showing prompts, tool calls, subagents, context fill, and cumulative cost, and Replay plays it back at up to 1200x. It also reads Claude Cowork sessions from ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/ and includes cost alerts, opt-in native notifications via Claude Code hooks, a one-click hardening baseline for ~/.claude/ with backup and revert, secret scanning of transcripts, and an optional read-only MCP server. All figures are local estimates computed from transcripts.
notable: Per-message token and cost view, plus a Trace timeline with Replay up to 1200x
One-click Claude Code hardening baseline that is reversible via auto-backup
Optional read-only MCP server so Claude Code can query your own usage data
Runs locally with zero telemetry; MIT licensed
caveats: macOS only; Cowork session support depends on files in ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/
Cost figures are estimates computed locally from transcripts, not billing records
Notifications for Ghostty, iTerm2, or Terminal.app focus only; other terminals are not named
Cost alerts and MCP server are optional and off by default
